title: $Lg^*\cong D(g^*)$
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a closed symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian category with additive
tensor product and functorial flat resolutions, and $g\colon Z\to Y$ a morphism. The left
derived functor $Lg^*=L(g^*)$ of the pullback of [def-sfb-finite-upper-star], computed on
K-flat resolutions [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], is isomorphic to the functor

$$
D(g^*)\colon D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)\to D(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)
$$

obtained by applying $g^*$ levelwise.

proof.text:
$g^*$ is exact ([lem-sfb-finite-upper-star-exact]), so it preserves quasi-isomorphisms and
induces $D(g^*)$ with $D(g^*)\circ Q\cong Q\circ g^*$ on complexes. This exhibits $D(g^*)$
as a left derived functor of $g^*$. Uniqueness of left derived functors then gives
$L(g^*)\cong D(g^*)$; concretely, the comparison map
$L(g^*)(QK)\to Q(g^*K)$ is an isomorphism for every complex $K$, not only for K-flat ones.
